correctness.rationale: For fixed irreducible d×d Metzler L and diagonal zero-mean modulation V(s)=H'(s), analytic Dyson monodromy yields analytic simple Perron Floquet branch. The periodic Floquet vector expansion satisfies p1=Hv (mean-zero gauge); because ∫V=0 and ∫H'H=0, λ1=0 and constant correction c=0. At next order p2=Jv+(1/2)H²v+c2, J'=[M,H]. Averaging next equation against u yields λ2=∫uH'Jv=-∫uH[M,H]v=∫u(λ0 H²-HMH)v. Using both left/right Perron identities symmetrizes to ½∫Σ_(i≠j)u_i L_ij v_j(H_i-H_j)², valid directed without detailed balance. Metzler edge weights and positive u,v imply E≥0 and strongly connected directed graph forces H_i all identical at equality, exactly when r_i-r_j are time-constant. Analyticity then Λ'(T)=2 ET+O(T²), positive for small T, and common waveform leads to exact e^{TM} case. Independently checked script’s rational covariance/energy formulas for directed 3-cycle 2-phase E=1/48; three-phase E=34/351 is a bounded example, not the general proof.

value.rationale: The sign of the first nonzero rapid-switching correction for an arbitrary directed strongly connected mixing graph is an important sharp analytic invariant; exact zero/equality characterization and strict local period growth clarify a boundary where prior nonsymmetric global conjectures fail. Positivity independent of reversibility and phase number is a meaningful structural extension, not just a numeric coefficient.

limitations: Result asserts only small T and finite-dimensional fixed irreducible L with bounded periodic diagonal coefficients, not global monotonicity or varying off-diagonal coupling.
Historical bibliography cannot be exhaustively ruled out; no expert/Lean attestation is inferred from the code or this review.
